name: Sign in, bootstrap an account workspace, and retain a record
description: Verifies an uninitialized account can bootstrap from browser state or default records, then a server-backed record survives reload.
steps: Sign in using the AppDeploy authentication popup
On an uninitialized account, allow the one-time browser-to-server bootstrap to finish
Open Businesses & products and create 'Persistence QA Record' with a non-empty purpose
Wait until the workspace sync indicator shows Account synced
Reload the page and wait for the workspace to load
Search for 'Persistence QA Record'
expected: The synthetic record remains present after reload with its saved fields, and the workspace shows an account-synced state.

name: Reject an incomplete portfolio record
description: Verifies that a business/product cannot be created without its required name, type, and intended outcome.
steps: Sign in and open New business / product
Enter a name and type but leave Purpose and intended outcome blank
Submit the form
expected: A visible validation error is shown and no incomplete record appears in the portfolio.

name: Persist a build task with its business association
description: Creates a synthetic task linked to a business record and verifies the link and task survive a refresh.
steps: Sign in and open Build board
Create a task 'Persistence QA Task' with details and acceptance criteria
Associate it with 'Persistence QA Record' if present, otherwise with the portfolio platform
Wait for Account synced and reload the page
Open Build board and locate 'Persistence QA Task'
expected: The task remains present after reload with the same association, status, priority, and acceptance criteria.

name: Keep provider candidates separate from live connections
description: Verifies candidate providers remain unconnected until an operator records tested evidence; the test does not call a third-party provider.
steps: Sign in and open Integrations
Inspect n8n and OpenAI API records
Verify the Verified count remains zero unless separate test evidence exists
expected: Candidate providers are visible as candidates and no connection is inferred from their documentation links.

name: Keep one account's portfolio private from another account
description: Uses separate synthetic test actors to check that server records written under one authenticated account are not returned to another account.
steps: Actor A signs in and creates 'Actor A Private QA Record'
Wait for Account synced, then sign out
Actor B signs in with a different test account
Search for 'Actor A Private QA Record'
Inspect Actor B's workspace and verify the record is absent
expected: Actor B cannot see or modify Actor A's record; each actor receives only records from their own authenticated workspace.
